title: The first branch
summary: Branching wheel, drag/Invoke workflows, custom actions and read-only text preview.

title: A home for your settings
summary: Native Control Center, daemon lifecycle and persistent settings.

title: Images, converted
summary: PNG/JPEG/WebP conversion, Advanced Convert and durable background Jobs.

title: Another way to branch
summary: Optional Concentric Rings, layout fallback and hardened non-actionable drop handling. Branching remains the default.

title: Native Wayland research
summary: Portal, layer-shell and desktop-specific integration ideas need investigation. There is no shipping native wheel backend.

title: More contexts and Open With
summary: Text, URLs, clipboard contexts and dynamic application providers appear in design notes. They are not current product capabilities.

title: System tray integration
summary: Deferred while lifecycle remains available in Control Center and the user service.

title: Additional conversion backends
summary: The discovery/routing framework exists, but the external vips adapter is deferred. Historical version suggestions are not current commitments.
